docs.title: Cloudflare Game Search Setup
docs.text:
This project now includes a Cloudflare Pages Function for live game search:

  • API route: /api/game-search?q=your-query
  • Static site build command: mkdocs build
  • Static site output directory: site

docs.title: 1. Cloudflare Pages
docs.text:
Create a Cloudflare Pages project and point it to this repository.

  • Build command: mkdocs build
  • Build output directory: site

Cloudflare will automatically detect the functions/ directory and deploy the API route.

docs.title: 2. Required Environment Variables
docs.text:
The live search function does not require Google API keys anymore.

You only need this build variable in Cloudflare Pages:

  • PYTHON_VERSION=3.11

docs.title: 3. Current Search Sources
docs.text:
The backend currently aggregates from:

  • Google Play via direct web search parsing
  • Apple App Store via iTunes Search API
  • TapTap via search results link
  • APKPure via search results link

docs.title: 4. Important Note
docs.text: If Google Play changes their page structure later, the Cloudflare Function is the only place you need to update. The frontend page can stay the same.

docs.title: Game Support & Troubleshooting
docs.text: If you encounter issues while downloading or launching games, please use this guide.

docs.title: 1. Common Issues & Solutions
docs.text:
Many common issues can be resolved through server-side configuration by our administrators:

  • Download Issues: Some games may not appear in the store or fail to download.
  • Launch Failures: If a game immediately crashes/closes after clicking "Open".
  • Error Pop-ups: If the game shows a system error or security warning before starting.
